title: Three Years and One Short Note
subtitle: 调查研究 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 调查研究（人与社会·科学与技术·调查与研究）
meta: 主题语境：调查研究（人与社会·科学与技术·调查与研究）　|　核心词汇：finding　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 finding 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1965 the researcher ① published a finding that no scholar in the field would have quoted, and he said the publishing was the whole of the year. The ② finding, meaning the result itself and not the report, ran three years and stayed unquoted in the book; a finding, he said, is the only thing in a field that is judged by how long it is left unquoted.

Every ③ finding in that field had the same short note beside it, and the ④ finding at the far bench, meaning the one they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A finding, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to quote; the researcher said the quoting is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the finding was the whole of the matter, meaning the verdict and not the result. The ⑥ finding, meaning the verdict and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody quotes; finding, he said, is either something you publish or the only word that means both a result and a verdict. He said the verdict is the part they remember.

By 1972 the ⑦ finding had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short note. The ⑧ finding of the whole thing, the researcher wrote in June, was one field and three years of quoting; finding, he said, is either the one at the far bench or the reason you learned to quote. He said the quoting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ finding I remember is the one quoted in the plan, which closed in 1974 and is still described as the quietest in the field. A ⑩ finding, my mother said in 1976, is the only one that improves by being quoted; every finding, she said, is a verdict that has agreed to look like a result. She said the verdict was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 发现；调查结果（指这一领域里每一项旁边的那一项）
B. n. 调查结果（指那一项本身，与报告相对）
C. 固定搭配：publish a finding 发表一项调查结果
D. n. 调查结果（指留给孩子们的那一项）
E. n. 调查结果（抽象总称，指一个领域的发现之事）
F. n. 调查结果（指计划里写到、被人引用过的那一项）
G. n. 裁决；判定（指一件事里人人都等却无人引用的那样东西）
H. n. 裁决（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人引用的那样东西）

items.q: published a finding that no scholar in the field would have quoted
The finding, meaning the result itself and not the report
the finding at the far bench
the finding was the whole of the matter
the finding had become a line in a plan
The finding of the whole thing
A finding, my mother said in 1976

answers.why: publish a finding 意为“发表一项调查结果”，1965 年那位研究者发表了一项这一领域里没有一位学者肯引用的结果。
finding 意为“调查结果”，指那一项本身而不是报告，它经过了三年而在簿子上没有被引用。
finding 意为“调查结果”，指这一领域里每一项旁边的那一项，每一项旁边都有同一张短短的便条。
finding 意为“调查结果”，指留给孩子们的那一项，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
finding 意为“裁决、判定”，指一件事里人人都等却无人引用的那样东西，叔叔说这项判定就是那件事的全部。
finding 意为“裁决”，指人人都等却无人引用的那样东西而不是那一项结果，是事情里人人都等、却无人引用的东西。
finding 意为“调查结果”，指计划里写到、被人引用过的那一项，到 1972 年这一项成了计划里的一行。
finding 意为“调查结果”，研究者六月写道，整件事的发现之事是一个领域和三年的引用。
finding 意为“调查结果”，我记得的是计划里引用过的那一项，1974 年结束了，至今仍被说成这一领域里最安静的一项。
finding 为抽象总称，母亲 1976 年说，一项调查结果是唯一会因为被好好引用而变得更好的东西。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1965 年那位研究者发表了一项这一领域里没有一位学者肯引用的调查结果，他说发表才是那一年的全部。（publish a finding）
那项调查结果，指的是那一项本身而不是报告，经过了三年而在簿子上没有被引用。（finding）
那个领域里每一项调查结果旁边都有同一张短短的便条。（finding）
最远那张长凳上那项调查结果，指的是他们留给孩子们的那一项，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（finding）
叔叔说这项判定就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那项调查结果。（finding）
1976 年母亲说，一项调查结果是唯一会因为被好好引用而变得更好的东西。（finding）
